item.text: The existing `Get` routes calls through a channel and uses a string key that treats `T` and `*T` as the same type. I’ll keep that API working and give `GetInstance` its own cache keyed by the exact Go type.

item.text: The new tests cover separate value and pointer instances, repeated retrieval, and 20,000 concurrent callers. The focused test is running now; I’m also refining the cache so constructors for different types can run independently.

item.text: `GetInstance` now uses a per-type `sync.Once`, so callers for the same type share one constructor run while different types can initialize independently. The regular focused test passed; the race-enabled run is still compiling and running.

item.text:
Added `singleton.GetInstance[T](constructor func() T) T` in [singleton.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton.go). It caches `T` and `*T` separately and runs each type’s constructor once, even under concurrent calls.

Added tests for reuse, type separation, and 20,000 simultaneous calls in [singleton_test.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton_test.go). The singleton package passes `go test -race`.
